EgressProxyIpPools.description_en: The list of egress proxy IP address pools

items.description_en: The egress proxy IP address pool information

AddressType.description_en:
The address type of the egress proxy IP address pool. Valid values:

Intranet: private network address. Only private network IPv4 addresses (PrivateIpv4Address) in a vSwitch can be added.

Internet: public IP address. Only elastic IP addresses (EipAllocationId) can be added
AddressType.description_zh:
出口代理地址池的地址类型。取值：

Intranet：私网地址。仅支持添加交换机内的私网 IPv4 地址（PrivateIpv4Address）。

Internet：公网地址。仅支持添加弹性公网 IP（EipAllocationId）

CreateTime.description_en: The time when the egress proxy IP address pool was created. The time is displayed in UTC in the `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ` format
CreateTime.description_zh: 出口代理地址池的创建时间。时间为 UTC 时间，格式为 `YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ`

Description.description_en: The description of the egress proxy IP address pool. The description must be 2 to 256 characters in length and can contain Chinese characters, English letters, digits, commas (,), periods (.), semicolons (;), forward slashes (/), at signs (@), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
Description.description_zh: 出口代理地址池的描述。长度为 2~256 个字符，支持中文和英文字母，可包含数字、半角逗号（,）、半角句号（.）、半角分号（;）、正斜线（/）、at 符号（@）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

EgressProxyGatewayId.description_en: The ID of the egress proxy gateway to which the egress proxy IP address pool belongs
EgressProxyGatewayId.description_zh: 出口代理地址池所属的出口代理网关 ID

EgressProxyIpPoolId.description_en: The ID of the egress proxy IP address pool
EgressProxyIpPoolId.description_zh: 出口代理地址池的 ID

EgressProxyIpPoolName.description_en: The name of the egress proxy IP address pool. The name must be 2 to 128 characters in length and must start with an English letter or a Chinese character. It can contain digits, periods (.), underscores (_), and hyphens (-)
EgressProxyIpPoolName.description_zh: 出口代理地址池的名称。长度为 2~128 个字符，必须以英文字母或中文开头，可包含数字、半角句号（.）、下划线（_）和短划线（-）

HashFactor.description_en:
The hash factor used for consistent hash scheduling. This parameter is returned only when the Scheduler parameter is set to ConsistentHash. Valid values:

SourceIP: source IP address.

FiveTuple: 5-tuple.

HttpHeader: HTTP request header
HashFactor.description_zh:
一致性哈希调度所使用的哈希因子。仅当调度算法 Scheduler 取值为 ConsistentHash 时返回。取值：

SourceIP：源 IP。

FiveTuple：五元组。

HttpHeader：HTTP 请求头

HashHeaderName.description_en: The name of the custom hash request header. This parameter is returned only when the HashFactor parameter is set to HttpHeader
HashHeaderName.description_zh: 自定义哈希请求头名称。仅当哈希因子 HashFactor 取值为 HttpHeader 时返回

Scheduler.description_en:
The scheduling algorithm for egress IP addresses, which specifies how egress IP addresses are selected from the IP address pool. Valid values:

Random: random scheduling.

ConsistentHash: consistent hash. If this value is used, the HashFactor parameter is also returned
Scheduler.description_zh:
出口 IP 的调度算法，即从地址池中选择出口 IP 的方式。取值：

Random：随机调度。

ConsistentHash：一致性哈希。取值为 ConsistentHash 时，会同时返回哈希因子 HashFactor

Status.description_en:
The status of the egress proxy IP address pool. Valid values:

Provisioning: The egress proxy IP address pool is being created.

Available: The egress proxy IP address pool is available.

Configuring: The configurations of the egress proxy IP address pool are being changed
Status.description_zh:
出口代理地址池的状态。取值：

Provisioning：创建中。

Available：可用。

Configuring：变配中

Key.description_en: The tag key. The key can be up to 128 characters in length and cannot start with `aliyun` or `acs:`. It cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Key.description_zh: 标签键。最多支持128个字符，不能以`aliyun`或`acs:`开头，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

Value.description_en: The tag value. The value can be up to 256 characters in length and cannot contain `http://` or `https://`
Value.description_zh: 标签值。最多支持256个字符，不能包含`http://`或`https://`

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of entries returned per page in the current query
MaxResults.description_zh: 本次查询返回的每页最大条目数

NextToken.description_en:
The token for the next query. Valid values:

If NextToken is empty, no next query is required.
If NextToken is returned, the value indicates the token for the next query
NextToken.description_zh:
是否拥有下一次查询的令牌（Token）。取值：

如果 NextToken 为空表示没有下一次查询。
如果 NextToken 有返回值，该取值表示下一次查询开始的令牌

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of egress proxy IP address pools that meet the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 符合条件的出口代理地址池总条目数
